prompt: Find and quote the _VALID_URL regex pattern(s) for the Facebook extractor class(es), especially any that match /share/p/, /share/r/, /share/v/, /reel/, /watch/?v=, /videos/, permalink.php, story.php, photo.php, groups/.../posts/, and fb.watch. Quote the exact regex strings verbatim.
content:
# Facebook Extractor URL Patterns

## FacebookIE Class

The primary `_VALID_URL` pattern matches various Facebook video URLs:

```
r'''(?x)
                (?:
                    https?://
                        (?:[\w-]+\.)?(?:facebook\.com|facebookwkhpilnemxj7asaniu7vnjjbiltxjqhye3mhbshg7kx5tfyd\.onion)/
                        (?:[^#]*?\#!/)?
                        (?:
                            (?:
                                permalink\.php|
                                video/video\.php|
                                photo\.php|
                                video\.php|
                                video/embed|
                                story\.php|
                                watch(?:/live)?/?
                            )\?(?:.*?)(?:v|video_id|story_fbid)=|
                            [^/]+/videos/(?:[^/]+/)?|
                            [^/]+/posts/|
                            events/(?:[^/]+/)?|
                            groups/[^/]+/(?:permalink|posts)/(?:[\da-f]+/)?|
                            watchparty/
                        )|
                    facebook:
                )
                (?P<id>pfbid[A-Za-z0-9]+|\d+)
                '''
```

This pattern covers: `permalink.php`, `story.php`, `photo.php`, `/videos/`, `/posts/`, `groups/.../posts/`, `watch/?v=`, and `watchparty/`.

## FacebookReelIE Class

```
r'https?://(?:[\w-]+\.)?facebook\.com/reel/(?P<id>\d+)'
```

Matches Facebook Reels specifically.
